in_marathi.name: Deepavathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Row of lights
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepavathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Deepavathi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘deepa’ meaning 'light' and 'vathi' meaning 'row'. This name is associated with the Hindu festival of Diwali, also known as the Festival of Lights. Deepavathi signifies the triumph of light over darkness and good over evil.
